text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (17.2% vs 2.3%, 244 claims, z 2.14, 55% low complexity, 30 records, 0 of 4 below billed, 7 of 24 no lab). The inconclusive leaning is supported by the hybrid_review tool output. But the narrative has an unsupported speculative inference and an internal tension, the cited examples are thin, and the next steps are generic and partly contradictory to the exchange outcome.","problems":["The sentence \"That may mean the notes were written up to match the bill\" is speculation not supported by the evidence; the charts matched billing and 7 of 24 lacking a lab on the claim does not show notes were fabricated.","The 29% figure (7/24) is a derived ratio the script could not match; it is legitimate but the headline and rationale both repeat the same finding redundantly.","Next step says records are \"too thin to judge,\" yet the exchange returned 30 of 30 usable charts with no deficiencies; the 4 documented 99215s are thin, but the step does not say that precisely and is generic.","Next steps do not name the specific claims or the 7 data-review notes to pull and check, nor request documentation for the cited 99215 visits.","Only two example claims are cited, both low-complexity 99215s, while 23 are available; none of the examples show the documented-supported or the data-without-test claims.","The \"55% of 99215s on 0 or 1 conditions\" claim is not cited to any specific supporting rows beyond two examples; the 0-condition claim has 0 conditions but Z09 only, which is not discussed.","Does not flag the mismatch between the 99215 documented sample (4) and the overall 42 99215 claims clearly, nor that two 99215 examples have no minutes recorded."]}
